evals.prompt: Design a test strategy for our quiz engine module. It handles quiz creation, question randomization, time limits, scoring, and grade calculation. Current test coverage is 23%.
evals.expected_output: Proposes layered test strategy (unit, integration, e2e), prioritizes critical paths (scoring, grade calculation), identifies edge cases, and sets coverage targets.
assertions: Designs a layered test strategy covering unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Prioritizes testing of critical business logic: scoring and grade calculation
Identifies specific edge cases (time expiry during submission, tie-breaking, zero-score scenarios)

evals.prompt: Perform a security audit plan for our FastAPI authentication system. It uses JWT tokens, OAuth2 with Google, password hashing with bcrypt, and session management with Redis.
evals.expected_output: Proposes audit covering OWASP Top 10, specific JWT vulnerabilities, OAuth2 misconfigurations, bcrypt cost factor, and Redis session security.
assertions: Plans audit against OWASP Top 10 with specific checks for each applicable category
Identifies JWT-specific risks (algorithm confusion, token expiry, secret strength)
Reviews OAuth2 configuration for common misconfigurations (redirect URI validation, PKCE)

evals.prompt: Our application has no observability. Propose a logging, metrics, and tracing strategy for a FastAPI application running on Kubernetes with PostgreSQL and Redis.
evals.expected_output: Proposes structured logging with correlation IDs, key metrics (latency, error rate, saturation), and distributed tracing with minimal performance impact.
assertions: Recommends structured JSON logging with request correlation IDs
Defines key metrics following RED or USE methodology for API, database, and cache
Proposes distributed tracing with performance overhead assessment

evals.prompt: Check our student data API for GDPR compliance. The API exposes: GET /students (lists all students with email and grades), GET /students/{id}/history (full activity log), and DELETE /students/{id} (soft delete only).
evals.expected_output: Identifies GDPR violations: listing all student PII without consent check, inadequate right-to-erasure implementation, missing data minimization.
assertions: Flags that GET /students exposes PII without proper access controls or consent verification
Identifies soft delete as insufficient for GDPR right-to-erasure compliance
Recommends data minimization on the list endpoint (exclude email/grades by default)

evals.prompt: Evaluate property-based testing tools for our Python backend. We want to generate randomized test inputs for our API validators, data transformations, and mathematical scoring functions.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates Hypothesis vs other property-based testing tools, proposes specific properties to test, shows integration with pytest.
assertions: Recommends Hypothesis as the primary property-based testing tool for Python
Defines specific properties to test (e.g., score always between 0-100, idempotent transformations)
Shows integration approach with the existing pytest test framework

should_trigger: Design a test strategy for our quiz engine module
Plan a security audit for our authentication system
Propose a logging and observability strategy for our FastAPI app
Check our student API for GDPR compliance issues
Evaluate property-based testing tools for our Python backend
should_not_trigger: Design an edge computing architecture for global latency reduction
Fine-tune a multimodal LLM for educational content
Build a Terraform module for AWS ECS deployment
Create a data pipeline with Kafka and Flink
